meta.name: lifecycle-messaging
meta.description: Designs automated email and SMS programs — welcome and onboarding sequences, nurture, re-engagement, transactional messaging, and the timing and segmentation behind them. Use this to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, improve open or click performance, set up SMS flows, or decide what messages a customer should receive and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并优化客户的邮件与短信自动触达流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要搭建客户邮件或短信的自动营销流程
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize automated email and SMS customer journeys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run customer messaging and need automated email or SMS flows.

howto.what: Claude 会按客户所在阶段(如新注册、已开始使用、有流失风险等)设计自动邮件/短信:产出欢迎、引导或挽回内容,给出各条消息的发送时机和频次;涉及短信时提醒同意与退订规则;并能针对打开、点击、退订问题给排查建议。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或修复邮件序列、规划生命周期自动化或设置短信流,或有同类客户触达决策(内容、时机)需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把欢迎邮件拆成三步,第二步该在什么时候发?
say.note: 它会按生命周期与时间节奏给出节点设计。

say.text: 我们的短信营销需要哪些合规要素?
say.note: 它会列出同意、退订、时区等要求。

say.text: 最近邮件打开率很低,怎么判断是标题还是信誉问题?
say.note: 它会按诊断路径建议先查可投递性。

howto.what_en: Claude plans email/SMS automation: maps lifecycle stages, designs welcome/onboarding/win-back sequence with timing and cadence, notes SMS consent/opt-out rules, and suggests fixes for opens/clicks/unsubscribes.
howto.when_en: When you ask to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, or set up SMS flows, or have related decisions about message content and timing.

say_en.text: Split my welcome email into three messages; when should the second be sent?
say_en.note: It will propose timing and content for each step.

say_en.text: What compliance elements do we need for our SMS marketing?
say_en.note: It lists consent, opt-out, quiet hours, and more.

say_en.text: Open rates are low—subject line or sender reputation?
say_en.note: It will guide you to check deliverability first.
